blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic
browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still
depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for
credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too
expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at
deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling
method built around conformal self-verification. During training,
the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its
own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only
question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a
training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through
polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into
per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge
baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused
as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the
agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the
self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative
majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current
incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three
settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art
performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a
bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time
and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical
harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the
benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a
live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results
position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge
feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free
test-time scaling signal.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Open-source web agents have reached the point where they can operate
realistic browser interfaces, but the verifier remains the bottleneck
for improving them with reinforcement learning. A binary success
signal is easy to deploy but too sparse for credit assignment: when
all rollouts in a GRPO group ( Shao et al., 2024 ) receive the same
outcome, the advantage estimate collapses. A frontier language model
judge ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) provides richer feedback,
but it is costly during training and cannot be assumed available at
test time. This tension is especially visible in web-agent benchmarks:
WAI ( Zhou, 2026 ) uses programmatic per-app verifiers,
VWA ( Koh et al., 2024 ) uses outcome-based URL/DOM
checks, and live-web suites such as OM2W ( Xue et al., 2025 ) depend on noisy LLM judges. The policy is often not the only limiting
object; the way we score and select its rollouts can dominate the
observed success rate.

CLIFT asks whether the judge’s feedback can be turned into a
reusable verifier that the agent carries with itself, rather than a
separate process reward model ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) or a post-hoc best-of- N N scorer ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Snell et al., 2025 ) .
CLIFT maintains a bank of natural-language verification questions
about web-agent behaviour and certifies which questions are reliable
at which URL states. The same bank is used in two places
(Figure 2 ). During training, certified bank evidence
is blended with the comparative judge to produce a denser per-step
reward and URL-stratified advantages. At test time, the trained agent
runs a greedy trajectory plus diverse retries; the frozen certified
bank summarizes each URL trace; and a conservative trajectory selector
keeps one emitted trajectory per task. The common object is not a new
model but a calibrated verifier:
a set of questions, URL scopes, polarity signs, and conformal trust
weights that can be reused after training.

The certifier is the part that makes this more than prompt
engineering. Each verification question carries a URL scope and a
polarity sign indicating whether YES is evidence of progress or
failure. A Mondrian adaptive conformal tracker ( Gibbs and Candès, 2021 ; Vovk, 2012 ) estimates whether that
question separates high- and low-judge rollouts at the relevant URL
granularity. Certified questions receive signed trust weights. During
training this gives a verifier reward that can only add evidence on
top of the judge baseline, preventing the reward-collapse failure of
earlier linear blends. During test-time scaling, the same signed
evidence is frozen and presented to a comparative selector over two
completed trajectories. In both cases, the question bank is a compact
interface between expensive judge feedback and the agent’s own
rollouts.

blocks.en:
We evaluate this idea in three complementary ways. On WAI, where
programmatic verifiers provide dense training supervision, CLIFT  improves a trainable open Gemma-4 agent and reaches the strongest
public 9-app score we are aware of; the point is both training and
CTS on the same open backbone. On VWA, where the evaluation is more
outcome-based, we use the bank created during Gemma-4 training as a
test-time verifier for GPT-5.5, showing that the learned verification
knowledge transfers to a stronger closed backbone and reaches
state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On OM2W, we
push transfer further: no agent is trained on OM2W; instead, the
certified question bank is translated and recalibrated, then used by
CTS to improve live-web test-time scaling. These three stories support
the same claim: conformal self-verification is useful both as a
training signal and as a reusable, judge-free test-time scaling signal.
Related work is discussed after the empirical section
(§ 6 ).

blocks.en:
The three benchmarks probe complementary properties of the same
verifier bank: WAI tests whether certified self-verification can train a stronger open agent, VWA tests whether the
trained-on-open bank transfers to a frozen closed backbone, and
OM2W tests whether the same bank recalibrates for live-web
zero-shot selection.

The cross-benchmark result also clarifies what transfers. The policy
does not: the Gemma rows use upstream weights and the GPT-5.5 rows
keep the closed model fixed. What transfers is the certified question
taxonomy plus the calibration recipe, which turns prior judge feedback
into structured evidence for a new live-web environment. Because the
bank is just a list of URL-scoped, polarity-tagged questions with
calibrated trust weights, recalibration on a new domain only requires
a sample of judge-scored rollouts; no policy update is needed to begin
selecting trajectories. Detailed bank construction and transfer tables
are in Appendix A.4 .

The decomposition further shows that the gain is not explained simply
by additional interaction or inference-time search. Vanilla GRPO
improves the base model by only 2.9 points while increasing the average
number of steps on successful trajectories from 15.4 to 18.5.
In contrast, CLIFT reaches a 10.8-point improvement with an average
of 16.0 steps, suggesting that the certified URL-local feedback primarily
improves credit assignment rather than encouraging longer trajectories.
CTS then adds a further 2.0 points while reducing the average to 15.5
steps. Together with its 17.8% swap rate and zero per-app regressions,
this supports the intended division of labor: CLIFT produces the
stronger policy during training, while CTS intervenes selectively at
test time when the certified bank provides sufficient evidence to prefer
an alternative rollout.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and future work
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
CLIFT’s failures are intended to be visible. On WAI and VWA,
many URL states accumulate enough observations for signed trust
weights; on OM2W, the noisier live-web judge leaves more questions
uncertified. This refusal is a diagnostic rather than a silent collapse:
it says the current judge, state partition, or question bank does not
support reliable distillation, and keeps noisy verifier evidence out of
both the training reward and the CTS selector.
blocks.zh:
CLIFT的失败是显而易见的。 关于WAI和VWA,
许多 URL 状态为签名信任积累足够的观察
权重; 在OM2W上, 名人现场网络法官留下更多的问题
无证相. 这种拒绝是一种诊断而不是一种沉默的崩溃:
说现任法官 国家分区 或问题银行
支持可靠的蒸馏,并保持噪音的核查证据
训练奖励和CTS选手

blocks.en:
The study is still bounded. We train one open-weight backbone and rely
on a frontier judge during training and bank construction; if that judge
is systematically biased, calibration can detect disagreement only
through observed data. The transfer results show that the bank can help
stronger closed-source agents, but not that one bank is universal across
all web domains. Stronger open web agents also carry misuse risk, so
deployment should retain rate limits and domain-specific safeguards.

在培训和银行建设期间担任边防法官;
校正只能发现分歧
通过观测数据。 转帐结果显示银行可以帮忙

全部网络域。 更强大的开放网络代理 也有滥用的风险,所以
部署应保留费率限制和特定领域的保障措施。

blocks.en:
A natural next step is to replace natural-language questions with
executable browser-state assertions written by a coding agent. The
agent would learn not only to act on the web, but also to write compact
checks that can be executed during rollouts and reused for test-time
selection, reducing dependence on a separate self-verification bank
while preserving auditability.

在保持可审计性的同时。

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
CLIFT sits at the intersection of web-agent benchmarks, RL credit
assignment, test-time search, and reliable verifier-based selection. The
closest systems usually improve one component of this loop: stronger web
interfaces for agents, denser reward signals for training, or calibrated
decision rules for deployment. CLIFT instead studies how one certified
verification bank can connect these components, carrying judge feedback
from online RL into test-time trajectory selection.
blocks.zh:
CLIFT 位于网络代理基准,RL信用的交叉点
任务、测试时间搜索和可靠的基于核查者的选择。 这个
最近的系统通常会改善这个循环的一个部分: 更强大的网络
用于代理的接口,用于培训的更密集的奖励信号,或校正
部署决定规则。 CLIFT转而研究如何认证
核查库可以将这些组件连接起来,携带法官的反馈
从在线 RL 到测试时的轨迹选择。

语言代理结合了推理,浏览器动作,以及工具(中野等,2021;姚等,2023b;申等,2023;史克等,2023;秦等,2024;;).
搜索方法在推断时间添加了考虑或树木扩张(Wei等,2022;姚等,2023a; 周来等, 2024a; 周来. Snell等人,2025;Song等人,2024;)
和现代网络、软件、桌面和包含的基准压力
现实界面(周克等,2024b;克克等,2024;邓克等,2023;姚克等,2022;施瑞德哈尔等,2021;杨克等,2024;谢克等,2024).
CLIFT 不同于即时级搜索,因为其选择器重用 a
认证的每个URL银行在RL训练中学习,而不仅仅是更多的样本.

blocks.en:
GRPO and related RLVR methods improve LLMs from scalar outcomes ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Qi et al., 2025 ) , while
agent variants refine credit assignment through stratification, anchor
states, success rates, or Monte-Carlo values ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) .
Process-verifier and rich-feedback methods provide denser supervision ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Hübotter et al., 2026 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ) ,
and LLM judges provide it for open-ended generations ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) .
CLIFT keeps GRPO but changes the reward object: judge feedback is
augmented by a certified self-verifier and normalised by URL state.

GRPO和相关的RLVR方法改进了从Scalar结果中得出的LLMs(Schulman等人,2017年;Shao等人,2024年;DeepSeek-AI,2025年;Qi等人,2025年),同时
通过分层、锚地改进信用分配
(Zhu等人,2025年;Feng等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年;Kazemnejad等人,2025年)

和LLM评委为不限名额的世代提供(Bai等,2022;Liu等,2023;Zheng等,2023;Rafailov等,2023).
CLIFT 保留 GRPO 但更改奖励对象: 法官反馈是
由经认证的自验证器所加并被URL状态所规范.

blocks.en:
Conformal prediction gives finite-sample reliability guarantees ( Vovk et al., 2005 ; Angelopoulos and Bates, 2021 ; Gibbs and Candès, 2021 ; Vovk, 2012 ) ,
with recent adaptations to language modeling, decision making,
off-policy prediction, LLM-agent routing, and LLM judging ( Quach et al., 2024 ; Lekeufack et al., 2024 ; Kuipers et al., 2024 ; Si et al., 2026 ; Badshah et al., 2026 ) .
Those works calibrate outputs, policies, or judgments; CLIFT calibrates
the verification questions themselves, using URL scope, polarity,
and a Mondrian-ACI trust weight. A CEGAR-style loop ( Clarke et al., 2000 ) turns judge rationales into reusable
specifications for both training and test-time selection.

以及最近对语言建模、决策、

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
CLIFT turns expensive judge feedback into a reusable verifier for web
agents: conformally certified URL-state evidence densifies training
reward, then the frozen bank supports judge-free Conformal Trajectory
Selection. Across WAI, VWA, and OM2W, the same bank helps train an
open model, transfers to a stronger closed model, and recalibrates for
live-web selection without policy fine-tuning. A trajectory score is
consumed once; a certified bank can be inspected, recalibrated, and
reused.
blocks.zh:
CLIFT 将昂贵的评委反馈变成可重复使用的网络验证器
代理商:经合格认证的URL状态证据使培训变质
奖励,然后被冻结的银行 支持无法官的 Conformal Trextory
选取. 跨WAI、VWA和OM2W, 同一银行帮助培训一个
开放型号,向更强大的封闭型号转移,以及重新校正
现场网络选择没有政策微调。 轨迹得分是
一次消费;可检查、重新调整和核证的银行;
复用过.

blocks.en:
The bank is the durable artefact behind all three results. Each
certified question carries a URL scope, a polarity sign, and a trust
weight derived from observed lift, with provenance back to the judge
rationale that introduced it. This makes the bank small enough to
ship with the agent, auditable when a result looks off, and
recoverable: when a question’s lift collapses on a new distribution,
the certifier withholds trust rather than amplifying noise. Together
these properties give one knob, namely what the judge taught the
agent to notice, that persists from training reward to test-time selection,
from open backbone to closed backbone, and from sandboxed verifiers
to live-web judges, and that stronger future judges can grow without
discarding what earlier rounds taught.
blocks.zh:
银行是三个结果背后的持久动脉。 每个
经认证的问题带有 URL 范围、 极性标志和信任
从观察到的起重物中提取出重量,从何处返回法官
提出它的理由。 这样银行就足够小了
与代理人同船,当结果消失时可审计,
可恢复性:当一个问题在新的分配中升起时,
验证人不信任而不是扩大噪音。 一起来
这些地产给一个把手,即法官所教导的
从培训奖励到测试时间的选拔,
从开放的骨干到封闭的骨干,以及从沙箱核查器
未来更强大的法官可以成长,而不能
抛弃了以前教的

blocks.en: A.2 CLIFT Training Setup

blocks.en:
This subsection documents the training setup for the reported
CLIFT checkpoint, organised into the four moving parts of the
system: the backbone and the task pool that drives RL rollouts; the
compute budget and shard layout; the per-rollout reward and
verification loop; and the certification rule that turns the running
bank into the deployment object loaded by CTS at test time. The
concrete hyperparameter values used by all four stages are listed
separately in § A.3 .

The reported CLIFT checkpoint trains Gemma-4-31B-it with a rank-8

the per-shard adapters are averaged element-wise and merged into the
base model for evaluation. OM2W is excluded from policy training
entirely; we use it only for bank transfer and CTS at evaluation.

three Docker environments via header-only navigation. Both seed sets
describe what the apps can do , not what the public benchmarks ask the agent to do .

These six illustrate three properties the certifier rewards: the
question must discriminate between high- and low-judge rollouts
(positive lift), it must be answerable from the trajectory by the
base self-verifier (not too low-level for the LoRA-detached Gemma-4
to read off), and its YES/NO must align with the judge’s separation
under the chosen polarity. Questions that fail these tests, e.g.,
ones that ask about UI elements specific to a single page or that
the base model cannot reliably answer, are demoted to neutral or
dropped by the polarity-veto rule of Eq. 5 .

The filter/rewrite stage keeps general web-interaction predicates
where possible and removes benchmark-specific app names or URL
patterns when they do not transfer. The expansion stage adds questions
for live-web failure modes observed on OM2W, including bot-block
pages, timeout or wandering behaviour, hallucinated extraction,
partial-filter application, search-vs-detail-page confusion, and
wrong-final-answer stops. The resulting 132-question bank uses the
same schema as the training-time bank, so CTS loads it without code
changes.

blocks.en:
Each question is scored on a stratified pass/fail rollout sample using
the base Gemma-4 verifier with logprob-extracted YES probabilities.
Lift is computed as the pass/fail separation of the YES probability.
Questions whose absolute lift is below the discrimination floor remain
in the bank with zero weight; they can be re-certified later on a
different rollout sample. Among the 100 certified OM2W questions, 75
have positive lift and 25 have negative lift, so the selector receives
both progress evidence and failure-mode evidence.
